title: The AWS CLI's own error banner, on stderr
why: The CLI never hands an interpreter an exception object or a response header: what it gets is the process's stderr, and a modeled error is rendered there as `An error occurred (<Code>) when calling the <Op> operation:`. The banner states the code the CLI resolved, which for an awsQueryCompatible service is the modeled shape, so a clause naming only the Query code does not match here either.

wire.stderr: aws sqs delete-queue: exit status 254: An error occurred (QueueDoesNotExist) when calling the DeleteQueue operation: The specified queue does not exist.

expect.name: a clause naming the modeled shape
a clause naming only the Query code
a near miss on the shape
